name: Holiday Martinelli's Sparkling Apple Cider & Lactose-Free Eggnog (Skip Citrus Wassail)
groceryIngredients: Martinelli's Sparkling Cider or Filtered Apple Cider
whyItWorks: 100% filtered apple cider and Lactaid/almond-milk eggnog let you toast the holidays with zero alcohol, zero fiber, and zero citrus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sip Martinelli's (let some fizz settle if carbonation bloats you), warm spiced apple cider (simmered with cinnamon sticks only—no orange slices!), or Lactaid Eggnog.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Traditional Holiday Wassail is simmered with orange juice, lemon juice, and orange peels—stick to pure Spiced Apple Cider!
